tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for joining. First, can you share how often you go to the cafeteria in your daily life and why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：谢谢你的参与。首先，你能分享一下你在日常生活中去食堂的频率以及原因吗？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. Here's another question. Some people think the cafeteria should provide some fast food like fried chicken or French fries, while others believe it shouldn’t offer such fast food，instead, they should only provide healthy diet. What’s your opinion?
tasks.analysis: 中文：我明白了。还有一个问题。有些人认为食堂应该提供一些快餐，比如炸鸡或炸薯条，而另一些人则认为食堂不应该提供这类快餐，而只应提供健康饮食。你的看法是什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Now when doing volunteer work in the cafeteria, do you prefer to complete tasks on your own or work together with others to finish them?
tasks.analysis: 中文：有意思。那么在食堂做志愿工作时，你更喜欢自己完成任务，还是与他人合作一起完成？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good points. Now, a final question. What do you think cafeteria can do to enhance the dining experience of students?
tasks.analysis: 中文：说得有道理。现在最后一个问题。你认为食堂可以做些什么来提升学生的就餐体验？
tasks.title: Interview
